# onetsolutions_hosting_cron_jobs (Data Source)

Lists the cron jobs of a web hosting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_web_hosting" "site" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

data "onetsolutions_hosting_cron_jobs" "site" {
  hosting_id = data.onetsolutions_web_hosting.site.id
}

# The line keys to import existing jobs as onetsolutions_hosting_cron_job.
output "cron_jobs" {
  value = {
    for job in data.onetsolutions_hosting_cron_jobs.site.cron_jobs :
    job.line_key => "${job.minute} ${job.hour} ${job.day} ${job.month} ${job.weekday} ${job.command}"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hosting_id` (String) The UUID of the web hosting to read from.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `cron_jobs` (Attributes List) The cron jobs, in the order of the web hosting's crontab. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cron_jobs))

<a id="nestedatt--cron_jobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cron_jobs`

Read-Only:

- `command` (String) The command the job runs.
- `day` (String) The day of month field of the schedule.
- `hour` (String) The hour field of the schedule.
- `line_key` (String) The line key of the job, to import it as an `onetsolutions_hosting_cron_job`.
- `minute` (String) The minute field of the schedule.
- `month` (String) The month field of the schedule.
- `weekday` (String) The day of week field of the schedule.
